messages:
Ivy: hi everyone, Ivy here ":wave:". quick onboarding ask: i'm mapping who to ping for common things so i don't waste cycles. short list: 1) who owns routing/fallback policies? 2) who approves Dedicated console access and capacity bumps? 3) who is paged for perf spikes vs model-quality regressions? any tiny cheat-sheet or links appreciated.

Raj: welcome Ivy! routing and fallback policies = eng-platform (they own regional routing too). Dedicated access + quota requests go through IT and eng-ops for capacity approvals.

Kelsey: paging cheat: perf/availability P0-P1 -> eng-sre oncall (pagerduty). eng-sre triages and will escalate to eng-platform for capacity, eng-runtime for kernel/kv issues, eng-ml for model regressions. If customers are affected tag #customer-impact and loop CS.

Ivy: thanks! is there a one-line access request template i can paste into IT?

Raj: paste this minimal template:
```
Subject: Dedicated Console Access - ivy@example.com
Requester: Ivy (ivy@example.com)
Manager: <manager-name>
Reason: onboarding + need to monitor routing for feature ABC
Requested: console read, project <proj-id>
Expected QPS: 60
Approvers: manager + eng-ops
```

Oncall-bot: Paging rules: P0/P1 -> eng-sre oncall. P2 with customer impact -> eng-sre + CS. Runbooks attached when available.

Legal-bot: Reminder: for any potential data exposure incidents CC security@redwood.com and legal@redwood.com per policy.

Ivy: filed the ticket and CC'd manager. thanks all for the quick pointers!
